system.description:
[Trigger: Immediately After Check] Used when you fail a [Defense Check]. The check is considered successful, but you must make a 2Sq [Instant Movement (Compulsory)] (the destination is decided by the GM). Once per scenario. A mechanical bow with a special mechanism. It allows for quick emergency evacuation by setting up an anchor, but it is very difficult to handle.

Strange Copper Plate [Core Material] (180G) + Great Bow (480G) + Fox Card (Basic) (90G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 10] (110G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (410G)
